environment.profile: local acceptance on Darwin arm64; synthetic fixtures only

BIO-OPS-003-AC01.finding: The accepted card-issuance dependency issues Card 001 and permits activation only through its authoritative one-active-card invariant.

BIO-OPS-003-AC02.finding: Reporting and replacement issue the next card sequence through the canonical card-issuance gateway without duplicating sequence logic.

BIO-OPS-003-AC03.finding: Replacement activation permanently revokes every earlier card with compensation protection before activating the replacement, so the prior card cannot reactivate.

BIO-OPS-003-AC04.finding: The canonical replacement path checks the latest production result and holds one shared per-card barrier through activation. Every production mutation takes the same barrier, eliminating the stale passed-production snapshot race.

BIO-OPS-003-AC05.finding: The composed path retains BIO-CRD-005's authoritative one-active-card invariant while production and lifecycle mutations are serialized across feature boundaries.

final_acceptance.reason: AC01-AC05 pass. The sequential composition gap and cross-feature time-of-check/time-of-use race are closed by production-gated replacement activation under a single host-layer barrier, registered once and verified by barrier-controlled tests with mutant discrimination.
